items.text: /shift slash command exists at .claude/commands/shift.md and invokes the agentic-developer skill (Artifact table)
agentic-developer skill exists at .claude/skills/agentic-developer/SKILL.md encoding kickoff -> iterate -> close playbook
/generalize-permissions skill exists with deterministic allowlist clustering + safety taxonomy
Objective YAML schema exists at .claude/schemas/objective.schema.json and validates the Objective at kickoff
Pre-shift readiness check verifies tokens, live connections, measure-runs, palette-sanity, clean git before iteration 1; any failure aborts
Iteration anatomy: Ground/Observe/Verify/Act/Measure/Judge/Journal/Next steps with Opus orchestrating each
Haiku output schema (measurement/context/primary_failure/observed_anti_patterns/confidence) is the data-reduction contract; confidence:low triggers Sonnet
Sonnet delegation contract: pattern-match commands against palette before bash, return wanted_commands, never escalate directly
Stability gate: counter >= target.stability.consecutive (default 2) AND >=1 measurement from a fresh trigger before declaring done
Authority model L1 paths-allowlist (objective.scope.paths glob) refuses Edit/Write outside scope at tool-call time
Authority model L2 high-risk denylist (Jenkinsfile/.husky/lockfiles/package.json versions/.github/CLAUDE.md/objective/settings.json) triggers bail not autonomous edit
Authority model L3 measurement-oracle bail gate (P7): cannot edit Objective/measure/measured fixtures without bail+proposed-change
Palette two-tier: settings.json durable + settings.local.json shift-scoped (// shift:<id>) cleaned at close; union checked before bash
Retrospective TEMPLATE.md ships with sections for harvest; migration-bridge brit/rakia sections annotated temporary
Open: shift resumption (/shift resume <id>) decision — atomic vs resume-from-journal+answer
Open: journal context-window strategy — trajectory-summary header vs full re-ground each iteration
